book.name: Lepelesin
book.title: LEPELESIN Jisas Klays Ne Jon Nop Takaw Jɨj We Gɨl Agyɨkak

content: Kɨli God yɨb nop dad aplanɨlak, man ne alaŋ

Pen takaw kɨl tɨkɨpin anɨb ak nɨŋɨd, sayn tap olap nɨgɨnek, God man ne alaŋ kanɨbtub yɨkɨl yek. Ned akɨl tek agek nɨgɨnek ak, tepayaŋ ak agɨl yɨp agak, Adek awl ape, tap kɨdek gɨnɨgab okok nep yomin agak.
Anɨb agaknɨŋ, God Kawnan ne ak ap yɨp bak laknɨŋ nɨgɨnek, God man ne alaŋ bɨ olap mɨdɨl, bɨnonɨm besɨg mɨdep adek sɨŋak besɨg yek.
Wak nop ak ke yɨbɨl lɨl, kab Kɨlmejɨk ayɨp kab Koniliyan ayɨp tek ñɨñakol gɨlɨg yek. Pen chɨben ak nop gaw gɨl, kab Emelal tek gugɨñ pagɨñ gɨl, yɨnɨg tɨk yapɨlɨg yek.
Bɨnonɨm besɨg mɨdep ne ak nab ayaŋ mɨdaknɨŋ, bɨawl besɨg mɨdep anep 24 okok lɨl kus gɨlak. Bɨawl anɨb okok chech kayɨg yɨmɨl, tap gol dɨl gɨlak nag ak, kɨmɨg cheg okok keke lɨl, besɨg yelak.

Bɨnonɨm besɨg mɨdep sɨŋak, añɨñak dɨlɨg, tɨmuk awl agɨlɨg, gu agek palsek amnak. Jɨj anɨb sɨŋak sup mɨlek anep kugul ak mɨlek gɨ yek. Sup mɨlek anɨb okok nɨm, God Kawnan ne ak tam pakɨl anep kugul lup ak.

Bɨnonɨm besɨg mɨdep ne yek jɨj sɨŋak, tap olap ñɨg solwala ak glas tek kɨd yɨbɨl agɨl yek. Besɨg mɨdep bak ne ak, tap kɨm mɨdep omɨŋal omɨŋal jak mɨd kus gɨlak. Tap anɨb okok wɨdɨn kɨli kuŋay nep kud okok mɨdɨl, wɨŋ okok mɨdɨl gak.
Tap kɨm mɨdep anɨb okok, olap chen layon tek lak, olap chag bulmakaw ñɨluk tek lak, olap bɨ jomulɨk tek lak, olap yawl duk pɨl palsek lɨ ajɨpal tek lak.

Pen tap anɨb okok mɨdupsek pɨlɨkɨd anep kagol ak lak. Wɨdɨn kuŋay yɨbɨl, adek okok dɨl, pɨlɨkɨd okok dɨl mɨdupsek yu gak. Pen subnab maynab ayaŋ, kɨmep ag mɨdɨlɨg agɨlak, God Bɨawl yɨbɨl, tap okok mɨdupsek gɨnɨmuŋ tek nep mɨdeb ak agɨlak. Ne bɨ suŋtep agɨlak. Ne bɨ suŋtep agɨlak. Ne bɨ suŋtep agɨlak. Ned yek, mɨñɨl mɨdeb, kɨdek yenɨgab agɨlak.
Pen tap kɨm mɨdep keke omɨŋal omɨŋal anɨb okok, bɨ bɨnonɨm besɨg mɨdep adek yek ak pel pelnep yenɨgab ak kɨlop tep gaknɨŋ, nop tep agɨlɨg yɨb nop dad aplanɨlak.

Aplanelak, 24 bɨawl okok, kɨli jɨj sɨŋak kɨgom yɨmɨl, bɨ bɨnonɨm besɨg mɨdep adek yek ak nop gos anep lɨlɨg Bɨawl yɨbɨl ak pel pelnep yenɨgab agɨlɨg, nag kɨmɨg cheg lɨlak ak tɨg asɨkɨlak. Tɨg asɨkɨl ne yek sɨŋak dɨyokɨl, yɨb nop dad aplanɨlɨg agɨlak,

God Bɨawl chɨn, nad tap okok mɨdupsek gɨlɨnak agɨlak. Gos nad nɨŋɨd tap okok mɨdupsek gɨlɨnak agɨlak. Gɨle, mɨñɨl tap anɨb okok mɨdupsek mɨdeb agɨlak. Anɨge, binɨb mɨdupsek kɨlop tep yɨbɨl gek, yɨb nep dad aplanɨl, kɨles nad muk okok yelak agɨlak. Anɨgebal nɨm, teplep mɨdeb agɨlak.
